Creator 使用只读检查与 Plugin Manager 管理持久插件。: Creator uses read-only inspection and Plugin Manager for persistent plugins.
关系图列出声明包、直接消费者和实现方；这些是结构关系，不表示实际调用时序。: The diagram lists the declaration owner, direct consumers and providers. These are structural relationships, not runtime call order.
当前服务的职责、角色、声明与实现: Current service responsibilities, roles, definitions and providers
工具策略、守卫与结果处理: Tool policy, guards and result handling
DSH Inside 是基于 DeepSeek Harness 官方源码制作的独: DSH Inside is an independent interactive guide based on the official DeepSeek Harness source. Task walkthroughs and service views make complex relationships readable.
服务名称、角色、声明包、实现方及直接消费者来自 capability-seams: Service names, roles, owners, providers and consumers come from capability-seams.md. The task flow is checked against agent-loop, tools and session. The whale layout, explanations, examples and playback timing are this project's teaching design.
可点击“减少动态”。模型无法显示时提供文字组件视图；平面关系图可随时使用。: Choose Reduce motion for a quieter view. If models are unavailable, use the text components; the flat relationship view remains available.
3D 视图支持拖动旋转、滚轮缩放和触屏双指缩放；“平面”会显示本步骤的二维组件关: Rotate by dragging, zoom with the wheel or a two-finger gesture. Flat view shows the current step's components. Select a component for its role. Expansion affects only the 3D view.
搜索中文、ctx key 或包名。“剖面”列出所选服务的声明、消费者和实现方。点: Search by name, ctx key or package. The service view lists definitions, consumers and providers. Selecting a provider changes only the teaching view, not a real configuration.
模型与工具如何配合: How models and tools work together
一次任务如何循环推进: How a task progresses through the loop
三维视图保留空间层级，并持续连接上一阶段与当前阶段。: The 3D view connects each teaching step to the relevant components.
同一任务对比四种预设: Compare four presets on one task
每条路线都是独立的教学演示，不会修改真实 DSH 配置。: Each route is a separate teaching simulation; no real DSH configuration is changed.
拒绝结果如何返回主循环: Returning a refusal to the loop
减少返回给主模型的中间数据: Return less intermediate data to the main model
摘要缺失细节后的原文回查: Recover missing details from original records
可切换三维与平面视图的 Harness 架构。也可通过接口图鉴访问全部服务。: Harness architecture in 3D and flat views. The atlas also lists every service.
平面视图固定布局与方向，适合逐步阅读完整任务流程。: Flat view uses a stable layout for reading the task step by step.
把一个服务单独展开，查看它的调用方、声明包和实现方。: Inspect one service, its consumers, definition and providers.
只定位日志能够支持的相关服务，不补画日志中没有的调用。: Show only services supported by the log; do not invent unrecorded calls.
分账、整理照片、改共享采购单……每个案例都从一句话开始，逐步展示 DSH 读了什: Splitting a bill, sorting photos, editing a shared shopping list: each case starts from one request and shows, step by step, what DSH read, which tool it called, and where it stopped to wait for you.
同一个模型，换一套预设，能用的工具就不一样。: Same model, different preset, different tools.
亮起的是这一步用到的组件，箭头指向这次数据交给谁。: Lit components take part in this step; the arrow shows where this step’s data goes.
这一步只点亮参与交接的服务，并列出它们之间传了什么数据。: Only the services in this handoff are lit, with the data they pass shown alongside.
会话一直在记录任务过程，由持久化插件写入存储。本页只在浏览器里播放教学数据。: The session keeps recording the task, and a persistence plugin writes it to storage. This page only plays teaching data in your browser.
任务进来后，会话记录和 Agent 执行各管一件事。这里用的是预先编排好的任务，: Once a task arrives, the session log and agent execution each have their own job. This is a prepared task; it does not read your files.
提示词和工具声明都由插件拼出来。模型只能用这次请求里交给它的工具，不能凭空调用别: Plugins assemble the prompt and tool declarations. The model can only use the tools exposed in this request.
模型根据读到的资料写答复。页面只显示结果和工具交接，不显示隐藏的思考过程。: The model writes its answer from what it read. The page shows results and tool handoffs, not hidden reasoning.
工具结果和助手输出会作为持久事实留在会话里。没有待处理的工作，本轮就结束；写入存: Tool results and assistant output stay in the session as durable facts. With nothing left to do, the turn ends; the matching plugin handles persistence.
本例假设已经配置了“移动前询问”的执行策略。只在提示词里写“先问我”，并不能强制: This case assumes an “ask before moving” policy is configured. Writing “ask me first” in a prompt does not enforce approval by itself.
拒绝结果照样经过结果处理，形成一条 tool/result，但它记录的不是“文件: The refusal still goes through result handling and becomes a tool/result, but what it records is not “files moved”.
助手说明移动没有执行，原有文件都还在。教学时间线播完，不代表真实 DSH 执行完: The assistant says the move did not happen and the existing files are untouched. The end of this teaching timeline is not a real DSH run finishing.
任务是改一份共享采购单。本例启用了文件观察策略；没有启用这项策略的配置，就没有下: The task edits a shared shopping list. This case enables the file-observation policy; setups without it do not get the protection shown below.
另一位家人加了鸡蛋。这是教学里安排的外部修改，不是当前 Agent 写的。: Another family member adds eggs. This outside edit is staged for the lesson; the current agent did not write it.
只改目标那一行。这层保护属于文件工具的修改；用 Shell 写文件，不能默认有同: Only the target line changes. This protection belongs to the file tools; writing files from the shell does not automatically come with it.
回复：牛奶数量已更新，鸡蛋还在。回复里的文字可以对照资料面板核对。: Reply: the milk quantity is updated and the eggs are still there. You can check the wording against the materials panel.
程序由模型写，PTC 运行时负责执行并接上异步工具绑定。这样做并不是绕开工具权限: The model writes the program; the PTC runtime runs it and wires up the async tool bindings. That is not a way around tool permissions.
程序汇总得到 9 个不同学号，S02、S03、S07 重复。Standard 用: The program finds 9 distinct student IDs, with S02, S03 and S07 repeated. Standard could compute this with a shell script too; speed is not compared here.
程序把需要的汇总交回模型，模型再写最终说明。示例数据可以在资料面板里自己算一遍。: The program hands the needed summary back to the model, which then writes the final explanation. You can recompute the sample data in the materials panel.
这场活动要查场地和预算两件事，先把两边的资料和目标定清楚。: The event needs two checks, venue and budget. First, pin down the materials and goal for each.
主 Agent 通过已配置的 subagents 提供方委派。本例用的是内置的进: The main agent delegates through the configured subagents provider. This case uses the built-in in-process subagent; other providers may not behave the same.
主 Agent 汇总两份结果。两段动画同时亮起只是画面安排，不能据此说真实调用是: The main agent combines both results. The two animations lighting up together is staging; it does not show that the real calls ran in parallel.
交付时写明容量和预算两个问题，并给出调整建议；问题没解决，就不写成“可以如期举办: The delivery states both the capacity and budget problems with suggested changes; unresolved problems are not reported as “good to go”.
插件安装和业务任务分两段讲：办公室出现了，不等于番茄钟做完了。: Plugin installation and the order itself are told separately: the office appearing does not mean the timer is done.
用只读检查找出实际可用的接口；查询客户端需要一个已连接的页面。挂载槽位不能靠猜。: Read-only inspection finds the interfaces that actually exist; client queries need a connected page. Mount slots are not guessed.
测试按写明的条件复查暂停，发现旧实现暂停后还在计时。这是编排好的失败分支，画面上: Testing rechecks pause against stated conditions and finds the old version still counting. This failure branch is staged, and it is shown as a failure.
Plugin Manager 可以停用 bundle，停用时保留依赖；移除会卸载: Plugin Manager can disable a bundle, which keeps the dependency; removal unloads it and changes dependencies. The buttons on this page do not touch DSH on your computer.
Creator 也能直接用现有工具。算一顿饭不必装插件，同样的需求反复出现时再考: Creator can use the existing tools directly. One dinner does not need a plugin; consider extending when the same need keeps coming back.
第一次下水：大肥鲸怎么把一件事办完？: First dive: how does the whale get a job done?
从官方介绍出发，跟一个完整任务走一遍：模型出主意，工具动手，执行循环催进度，会话: Start from the official introduction and follow one complete task: the model decides, tools act, the loop keeps it moving, and the session log keeps the books.
饭吃完了，账怎么算？三个人，三张小票: Dinner’s done. Who owes whom? Three people, three receipts
读三张小票，算出每人该摊多少，再给出一份照着转就行的转账方案，一分钱也算得清。: Read three receipts, work out each share, and produce a transfer plan you can follow as is, down to the cent.
它想挪你的照片，你说“不行”，然后呢？: It wants to move your photos. You say no. Then what?
系统先列出移动方案、请你批准；你一拒绝，文件操作就停在真正执行之前，一张照片都不: It proposes the moves and asks for approval. Once you decline, the file operation stops before it runs; not a single photo moves.
共享采购单撞车：你改牛奶，家人加鸡蛋: Shared-list collision: you change the milk, family adds eggs
任务只要把牛奶改成 4 盒，偏偏家人同时加了鸡蛋。系统得先发现版本冲突，再基于最: The task only changes milk to four cartons, but a family member adds eggs at the same moment. The system has to catch the version conflict and retry on the latest content, without losing a single egg.
三张报名表，谁报了两次？: Three sign-up sheets. Who signed up twice?
让一段程序一口气读完、合并、去重三张表，只把最后的统计交回主模型，中间数据留在程: One program reads, merges and dedupes all three sheets in one go; only the final tally goes back to the main model, and the intermediate data stays inside the program.
迎新会办得成吗？派两个子 Agent 去摸底: Can the welcome party happen? Send two subagents to find out
一个子 Agent 查场地坐不坐得下，一个查预算够不够，主 Agent 把两份证: One subagent checks whether the venue fits everyone, another checks the budget, and the main agent combines both. Spoiler: both come back with problems.
1200 份航行档案里，藏着三条关键线索: Three key clues hidden in 1,200 voyage records
找出改道目的地、批准人和原因；摘要漏了细节，就回原始记录再核一遍，不凭印象破案。: Find the reroute destination, approver and reason; when the summary drops a detail, go back to the original record instead of solving the case from memory.
大肥鲸开公司：像素办公室接到第一单: The whale opens a company: a pixel office takes its first order
老板只带来一句需求，办公室就忙开了：先把像素办公室装成插件，再让设计、开发、测试: The boss brings one request and the office gets busy: install the pixel office as a plugin, split the work among design, development and testing, catch a pause bug, fix it, then deliver.
大肥鲸一件件拆给你看。: Taken apart by one big whale.
